messages:
anna: Quick sync — prepping the observability beta launch checklist. need to lock scope for dashboards, tracing hooks, per-route cost breakdown, and error analytics. customer asks: per-route token cost, trace links from console to spans, and regression alerts on error-rate + latency. who can own each?
nisha: I can own dashboards + UX for the console surfaces. plan: 3 views — overview, per-route, and alerting hub.
anna: perfect. launch must include: basic routing metrics, token-cost column, and a single default alert template. no GA scope for full retention or advanced sampling.
sam: couple of constraints from infra: token-cost requires request-level token accounting in the router. we can emit a new `token_breakdown` field, but needs a light-weight schema to avoid perf impact.
miguel: tracing hooks: we should instrument `request_id` propagation and a small span at model selection + serving. full request traces are heavy; propose 1% sampling by default, with 100% for errors.
nisha: agreed on sampling. UX note: customers repeatedly asked for an explainer on how token cost maps to model variants — need a hover tooltip + link to docs.
anna: launch criteria proposal (draft):
- metrics: latency P95, error-rate, token_count per request
- cost: per-route token breakdown visible in console
- traces: request -> model span + link to raw trace (sampled)
- alerts: built-in templates for high error-rate and cost spike
- docs: short guide + example dashboard template
if we meet all, mark beta launch. objections?
sam: sounds fine. timeline risk: adding token_breakdown to every request will add ~3-5% CPU on router in our bench. need perf test before rollout.
miguel: also need an opt-in for customers with strict PII policies — traces must be scrubbed or disabled. we'll add a flag `tracing.enabled` per org.
anna: good catch. add to launch: org-level tracing toggle + doc note on PII.
nisha: question: retention defaults? 7 days for traces, 30 days for metrics? that keeps costs reasonable.
sam: 7/30 OK for beta. we'll need billing projection before GA.
anna: owners: nisha (dashboards + UX), sam (token instrumentation + cost tracing pipeline), miguel (trace hooks + sampling + privacy toggle). I'll own launch criteria + docs.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: observability/feature/token-breakdown -> staging at 2026-06-14T16:10:00Z
miguel: quick config snippet for sampling/PII toggle:
```json
{
  "observability": {
    "tracing": {
      "enabled": true,
      "sampling_pct": 1,
      "error_sampling_pct": 100,
      "pii_scrub": true
    },
    "token_breakdown": "summary_per_request"
  }
}
```
sam: looks good. for cost display we should present both raw token_count and normalized cost USD/token for the model variant. rounding to 3 decimals.
nisha: UI mock needed — i'll drop initial Figma before EOD. wants quick feedback from product+eng.
anna: action items:
- nisha: deliver mock and dashboard template (EOD + link)
- sam: perf test for token_breakdown on router (48h)
- miguel: implement tracing hook + sampling + privacy flag (PR by EOW)
- anna: draft beta launch checklist + docs (tomorrow)
anyone blocked?
sam: blocked on a small schema decision: inline token_breakdown vs sidecar event. leaning inline for correlated metrics.
miguel: inline is easier for linking traces, but we should compress it: `t:{in:xx,out:yy}` style to keep footprint small.
anna: ok decide inline compressed format for beta. sam, can you validate size overhead in perf test?
sam: yup.
nisha: tagging product-marketing for beta messaging after we have docs. cc @product-marketing in docs PR.
anna: thanks all. will follow up with a formal checklist and PR links. :rocket:
